conclusion.paper_test_protocol: not separately frozen in a saved evaluation artifact; current evaluator default is deterministic
conclusion.reason: finite updates and nonzero Actor gradients/steps; Macro KL is very small versus target 0.1, so Macro policy changes are conservative but nonzero as confirmed by parameter deltas. High positive Macro/Micro EV and no visible value-loss runaway. Critic norm saturation is persistent. Return/P_KEEP/entropy/KL do not jointly establish a plateau.

critic_health.interpretation: EV is value-fit evidence, not Actor convergence evidence.

deterministic_cache_semantics.formal_protocol: not separately frozen in existing evaluation artifact
deterministic_cache_semantics.group_aware_helper: sums probability by group then selects raw-score best in UPDATE; called by Micro sample_micro_head for UAV STAY/MOVE, not unified Macro Cache
deterministic_cache_semantics.group_effect: P_UPDATE_GROUP can exceed P_KEEP while each individual UPDATE probability is below P_KEEP, so flat argmax chooses KEEP
deterministic_cache_semantics.unified_macro: flat argmax of corrected individual candidate logits/probabilities
